One lakh in 2016. Four choices. Your favourite one probably lost.
Ten years. September twenty sixteen to September twenty twenty six. Same one lakh, four places, and you never touch it.
Choice one. Cash in the cupboard. Still one lakh today. But prices rose about sixty three percent, so it buys only what sixty one thousand bought back then.
Choice two. An SBI fixed deposit, renewed every year. One lakh eighty five thousand, before tax. After inflation, you barely moved.
Now guess which one won. Most people get this wrong.
Choice three. The Nifty fifty, with dividends reinvested. Two lakh ninety six thousand. About eleven and a half percent a year, through demonetisation, covid and every crash.
And choice four. Gold. Four lakh seventy one thousand. Sixteen point eight percent a year. Almost five times your money.
But wait. Gold has already fallen twenty two percent from this year's peak. The last ten years don't promise the next ten.
So which would you pick for the next ten? Comment gold or Nifty. And send this to the friend whose money is still sitting in an FD.
